problem_statement: This is the Notus Svelte component starter kit (a client-routed Svelte + Rollup single-page app whose plain pages — Home, Landing and Profile — each mount the same shared Footer component, alongside admin and auth layouts). The kit is a UI-component showcase: it packs a Tailwind component library and helps developers preview and adopt it. The maintainer wants a native 'Browse the component kit' gallery pinned into the shared Footer so it appears on every plain page. The gallery carries a heading, a row of category filter chips (All, Buttons, Cards, Inputs, Navigation), a live result readout ('Showing N components · Category'), and a preview grid of component cards — each card names a component family, its variant count and a short descriptor, with a small gradient swatch. Ship the browser so it (1) appears on every plain page — Home, Landing and Profile — through the shared Footer, not just the Home page, (2) lays out its filter-chip row and preview grid responsively so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone, (3) matches the kit's own light blueGray/lightBlue card styling (white rounded cards with the kit's soft shadow and lightBlue accent, a filled active chip — not an off-palette dark slab with overlapping clipped cards and a ghosted active chip), and (4) keeps the result readout in sync with the filter so clicking a category updates the readout to that category's shown count (for example 'Showing 2 components · Buttons'). Keep the rest of the kit — the navbar, the plain pages, the kit images, the static build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Browse the component kit' gallery to the Footer component so it renders at the bottom of every plain page (Home, Landing, Profile) via one shared component, not a per-page copy.

The gallery shows a 'Browse the component kit' heading, a row of category filter chips (All, Buttons, Cards, Inputs, Navigation), a result readout, and a preview grid of component cards (each with a family name, variant count and short descriptor).
The filter-chip row and the preview grid must reflow responsively so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).

Style the gallery in the kit's own light blueGray/lightBlue card language (white rounded cards with the kit's soft shadow and its lightBlue accent, and a clearly filled active chip), consistent and legible, not an off-palette dark slab with overlapping cards.

Wire the result readout to the filter: after clicking a category chip, the readout must report that category's shown count (for example 'Showing 2 components · Buttons') — it must re-read the live filter state, not show a stale captured value.
Preserve the navbar, the plain pages, the kit images and the static build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the Creative Tim notus-svelte kit (notus svelte), a plain Svelte + Rollup + Tailwind component showcase whose Home, Landing and Profile views each import the same shared components/Footers/Footer.svelte. The 'Browse the component kit' gallery is a single shared component mounted inside that Footer so it reaches every plain page; its preview cards describe the kit's own component families (buttons, cards, inputs, navigation) with variant counts, and the category chips filter the grid live. The remote Google Maps script tag was neutralised and the root-path bundle prefix was fixed so the kit serves and runs offline with no network fetches. The responsive chip-row and preview-grid layout, the kit-native light card styling, and the live filter-readout wiring were designed by hand for this kit, not bulk-generated.
design_constraints: Implement the component browser as a single shared component mounted from the Footer so one source of truth reaches every plain page; do not paste divergent copies per page or build a detached widget.

The filter-chip row and the preview grid must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so they never force horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile; card spacing must stay legible with no overlap or clipping.

The browser must adopt the kit's own light card tokens (white rounded cards, blueGray text, lightBlue accent, the kit's soft shadow) and typography, and the active filter chip must be clearly filled and legible, so it reads as part of the kit, not a foreign block.
The result readout must reflect the CURRENT filter after every category click by reading the live shown count, so it can never go stale relative to the visible grid.
Do not remove or regress the navbar, the plain pages, the kit images or the static build.

change_completion: The component browser is present at the bottom of every plain page — Home, Landing AND Profile (the shared Footer component reaches all plain pages, not just Home).

After clicking a category chip on the Home page, the readout updates to that category's shown count (for example 'Showing 2 components · Buttons') — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 8 components · All'.
design_consistency: The gallery on the in-viewport states matches the reference's light card styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not an off-palette dark slab with overlapping clipped cards.
The gallery adopts the kit's own white rounded cards, blueGray text and lightBlue accent, with a filled active chip, so it reads as part of the kit across the pages.
responsive: No captured page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the chip row and preview grid wrap.
desktop_rollout_home, mobile_rollout_home and mobile_initial keep the browser readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The navbar and the plain pages remain present and functional.
The kit images and the static build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the kit home and responsive shell.
desktop_landing, mobile_landing and desktop_profile protect the existing plain pages and carry the component browser.
desktop_rollout_home and mobile_rollout_home scroll the component browser into view and must show the light card gallery without horizontal overflow.
desktop_rollout_landing and desktop_rollout_profile protect the browser's presence on the Landing and Profile pages.
tablet_rollout_home protects the browser's tablet layout without overflow.
toggle_density_home clicks a category chip; the readout must then report that category's shown count.
